description: REPLACE a price book's entire quantity-break grid (full-replace semantics: the supplied list becomes the whole grid; prior breaks are removed). Price changes automatically flag affected live quotes Stale and alert the operator. Empty lists are refused — clearing a grid is an operator action. A client-pinned token can only modify its own client's books, never the shared house books. Max 500 breaks per call. Set dryRun=true to VALIDATE the new grid and preview the diff (wouldRemove = current breaks, wouldAdd = new breaks) without removing, inserting, or flagging any quote Stale — the book is left unchanged. Alternatively set preview=true for the governed two-step protocol (a validated diff plus a single-use previewReceipt); repeat with that receipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

breaks.description: The complete new grid: specKey (cost-driver attribute values, e.g. {"trim": "6x9"}), minimumQuantity, unitCost, setupCost, isActive.

dryRun.description: Preview only (legacy dry-run): validate the new grid and report the diff (wouldRemove/wouldAdd) without changing the book. The response has DryRun=true and ReplacedCount=0. Short-circuits the governed protocol below.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured old→new grid diff plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
